verdict.rationale: Medusa documents its own Product Module, so it does ship a native catalog-modeling capability. However, nothing in the pack shows variants, options, or custom fields on products, and a community member noted that metadata appeared for orders but not products. The generic framework-customization claims are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented product variants and options, custom fields/metafields on products, flexible schema beyond a fixed template, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can model products with variants, options, and custom fields/metafields that fit my catalog, not a fixed template
